CREATE TABLE ttl_column_skip_untouched_blocks ( ingested_at DateTime, event_time DateTime, tenant_id UInt32, event_id UInt64, request_body String TTL event_time + INTERVAL 30 DAY ) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY tuple() ORDER BY (event_time, tenant_id, event_id) SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, merge_max_block_size = 8192, vertical_merge_algorithm_min_rows_to_activate = 1000000000, max_number_of_merges_with_ttl_in_pool = 0
